rationale: Classify as manual measurement harness, not an automated regression. Preserve original experiment and baseline guard; current skip-record semantics supersede historical throwing policy.

cases.title: child: reader measurements
cases.reason: Run actual JSONL reader with a real native createReadStream adapter; collect read bytes, decoded bytes, cursor/tail/error and heap/external/maxRSS statistics. Errors are caught and printed, not asserted.

cases.title: real 64 MiB input and isolated child driver
cases.reason: Create a real 64 MiB line, build before/after readers and run four bounded child processes; only nonzero child status rejects, metric values have no pass/fail checks.

cases.title: counted baseline record-budget removal
cases.reason: Baseline requires exactly three assertSessionTranscriptRecordBytes lines before stripping them; current source has zero and now skips oversized records instead of throwing.
